components.name: Text Action Link
components.description: Editorial anchor action with horizontal translate hover.
components.css: .ds-text-action-link { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: #131e33; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid #131e33; padding-bottom: 3px; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-text-action-link:hover { color: #0284c7; border-color: #0284c7; transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Preset Chip
components.css: .ds-preset-btn { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; background: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid #e5e9f0; color: #52617a; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-preset-btn:hover { background: #131e33; color: #ffffff; border-color: #131e33; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Clarity Score Chip (Airtight)
components.css: .ds-score-chip { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; }

narrative.overview: Echo treats prompt engineering as precise compilation rather than casual chat. Swiss editorial clarity meets kinetic acoustic resonance.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast gallery canvas (#fbfcfd) paired with deep marine navy (#131e33)
Editorial text hyperlinks rather than chunky button pills
Exact geometric 3-slab stepped monogram with sharp 90-degree right angles
Kinetic acoustic soundwave ripples and 3D parallax tilt

rules.name: The 5% Cyan Rule
rules.body: Resonance Cyan and Electric Blue are precision instruments, not wallpaper. They occupy less than 5% of any viewport surface.

rules.name: The Strict Kicker Rule
rules.body: Section kickers are always set in uppercase JetBrains Mono with 0.08em letter-spacing.

rules.name: The Tonal Layering Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by value contrast and 1px hairline rules, never by heavy black drop shadows.

dos: Do maintain clean gallery canvas (#fbfcfd / #ffffff) with deep marine navy (#131e33).
Do preserve the exact 3-piece geometry of the stepped 'E' monogram.
Do pair Plus Jakarta Sans with JetBrains Mono.
donts: Don't add generic SaaS boilerplate tropes: muddy glowing drop shadows or neon pill buttons.
Don't connect the three slabs of the 'E' monogram with a vertical spine.
Don't use centered generic blog layouts.
